name: tax-relief-status-checker
description: App for NJ residents to check the status of their property tax refund

scripts.package: npm run package --prefix lambda && npm run package --prefix lambda-anchor-autofile-api
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run package && cd infra && cdk deploy -c stage=dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run package && cd infra && cdk deploy -c stage=prod
scripts.lockfile: rm -rf webapp/node_modules lambda/node_modules infra/node_modules lambda-anchor-autofile-api/node_modules node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
